articles.title: Bryce Eldridge’s rookie season for the Giants puts him in rare, impressive company
articles.description: Eldridge is quietly putting up numbers in his age-21 season that put him in rarified company in the history of the game.

articles.title: What in the heck was wrong with Rafael Devers in April, anyway?
articles.description: Devers was one of the worst all-around players in baseball in April. Now that it’s in the past, let's examine that outlier of a month.

articles.title: Why the Giants’ crowded 60-day IL list will create roster madness this winter
articles.description: The Giants are leading the league in 60-day IL usage. The 60-day IL disappears in the offseason. That's when the roster crunch will begin.

articles.title: The Giants have too many outfielders, which is a good problem to have
articles.description: The Giants realistically have seven outfielders between Triple A and the big leagues who could get at-bats for them next season.
